versions.changelog:
Global 1.2B Literature Knowledge Base skill v1.0.0 changelog

- Initial release of 全球12亿文献知识库（8千万中文期刊可下载） skill.
- Supports search and download of 80 million licensed Chinese journal articles and 1.228 billion global literature metadata records (journals, patents, conferences, theses, standards).
- Provides bilingual (Chinese/English) keyword search, literature details, core-journal-priority ranking, PDF downloads for Chinese journals, and free multi-channel OA access for foreign literature.
- Enforces email registration and per-API-call quota management; 100 free searches and 10 downloads/month per user.
- Full flow for new user registration via email and code verification detailed.
- Quota model, per-call consumption, and upgrade/plan dialog logic included.
